answer: Farming becomes a timber bet on surviving 102 epochs of grading, and every haven settlement recomputes the quartz schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 102 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
